name: Rowan Company Furniture
old_description: At Rowan Company, we understand that furniture is an investment and the buying process can often be overwhelming.
about:
Rowan Company Furniture operates a showroom at 1207 Laurens Road in Greenville, South Carolina. The business opened in 2003 and remains owner‑operated, with the founder describing a vision to “be different, offer fair prices, and do our best to take care of the customer.”

The company retails a curated mix of new furniture from brands such as Taylor King, Lee Industries, Sarreid, Uttermost, Visual Comfort and Woodbridge Furniture, alongside vintage and antique pieces sourced globally. In addition to sales, the firm provides in‑house interior design services for projects ranging from single accessories to whole‑home furnishings.

Primary customers are residential buyers and interior designers seeking higher‑end home furnishings. The showroom serves the Greenville metro area, and the design team works with clients on everything from picture frames to complete house installations.

The founder states the business was built on a meticulously chosen product assortment, a “dream team” of designers, and a commitment to fair pricing and personal service rather than volume‑driven sales.
built_on: Meticulously curated showroom featuring top brands and antiques
In-house design team for projects from single pieces to whole homes
Commitment to fair pricing and customer care
type_evidence: We carry only the top brands in the furniture industry as well as quality antiques from around the world.
